buildings.name: Basic Extractor Yard
buildings.effect: Adds a silicate extractor to the lease it stands on; its cycles add Silicates to the station's inventory.

buildings.name: Assembly Facility
buildings.effect: Lets the corporation fabricate mining probes.

buildings.name: Refinery
buildings.effect: Runs a refinery chain, turning raw resources at a station into refined products each cycle.

buildings.name: Ferric Mining Complex
buildings.effect: Returning mining probes deposit a quarter more Nickel and Titanium, the inputs to the nickel and titanium refinery chains.

buildings.name: Refinery Complex
buildings.effect: Upgrades one Refinery in place: its production runs deliver half as much again of every output.

buildings.name: Cryo-vapor Extractor Array
buildings.effect: Built on a Luna lease, it cools that lease's extractors: they mine a fifth more Silicates.
